headline: Bitcoin Slides Toward $60,000 as Crypto ETF Outflows Surpass $2.5 Billion
summary: Bitcoin traded down toward $60,000 as institutional cryptocurrency fund redemptions exceeded $2.5 billion in 2026, extending an ongoing sector-wide bear market.
why: Cryptocurrency assets serve as liquidity proxies and risk sentiment gauges. Institutional ETF flows reflect broader market willingness to hold digital tokens.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Multi-billion dollar exchange-traded fund net outflows directly reduced demand for the digital asset.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent net redemptions from spot cryptocurrency ETFs pushed Bitcoin prices lower toward key psychological support levels.
